    Unary boundary complexes for pure string endpoints #

    A pure-positive string which is maximal at its right endpoint but has a left hook has a one-middle Butler--Ringel boundary complex. The kernel of the left-hook projection is the positive arm before its first negative letter; its inclusion is a maximal right cohook. This file constructs that kernel word, proves the resulting coordinate sequence short exact, and proves both differentials irreducible in the finite module category.
